# The Reading Room — Chat with your PDFs

A Streamlit front end for your RAG pipeline: upload PDFs, they get chunked,
embedded (HuggingFace `all-mpnet-base-v2`), stored in an in-memory Chroma
vectorstore, retrieved with MMR, and answered by Mistral.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Create a `.env` file next to `app.py` (optional — you can also paste the key
into the sidebar at runtime):

```
MISTRAL_API_KEY=your_key_here
```

## Run

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

## Using it

1. Open the app — if no `MISTRAL_API_KEY` is set, paste one into the sidebar.
2. Drag one or more PDFs into "Accession into archive" and click the button.
   The sidebar's "Card Catalog" will list each file with its page/chunk counts.
